## META: Split Shots - Improved AI Extraction

**Changes from original:**
1. Explicit numbered grid position prompts ("position 1", "row 1, col 1")
2. Batch processing (2 at a time with 3s delay) vs serial
3. Validation node catches failed extractions
4. Error handling on HTTP node (continueErrorOutput)
5. 120s timeout (vs default 60s)

**Known limitations:**
- AI extraction is inherently non-deterministic
- ~80-90% success rate expected
- Consider Cloudinary URL-based approach for 100% reliability
